comment: What Maven does not say, for the open-source licenses list (docs/adr/0002-open-source-licenses.md). An id with a colon completes that dependency (its values replace the POM's, its version stays the dependency's); any other id is a library of its own. Licenses are SPDX ids with a text in texts/.

libraries.name: TDLib
libraries.description: Telegram Database Library, the cross-platform library for building Telegram clients that Pingogram is built on.

libraries.name: Google Sans Flex
libraries.description: The variable typeface of every text in Pingogram, bundled with the app.

libraries.name: Material Symbols
libraries.description: Google's icon set; Pingogram's icons are Material Symbols Rounded, converted to vector drawables.

libraries.name: Unicode Emoji data
libraries.description: The emoji of the emoji panel and their groups, from Unicode's emoji-test.txt, bundled with the app.
